description:
Company Payroll Setup

Five short steps, prefilled with what the company already has: canton, UID and the person in charge of the payroll; the rates of the AVS fund, LAA, IJM, LAAC and family allowance policies; how salaries and social charges are booked and on which accounts; the salary certificate header. It creates the company's default social insurance configuration. Run it again any time to change a choice.
name: Configure the Company Payroll
title: Set up the company's payroll: insurances, accounting, certificate
